caption: Figure 2. Branch-resolved unguided depinning. (a,b) Positive- and negative-y branch-followed thresholds for the prepared ground family and competing metastable family. (c) The positive energy margin U_meta-U_ground shows that the prepared family remains the lower zero-force minimum over 0-3 deg. (d) Positive stability margins F_c^ground-F_c^meta in both force directions show that the prepared branch remains the last survivor over the same sampled interval.
